cohort: The study included 282 pregnancies from 224 pregnant patients with epilepsy seen at the maternal-fetal medicine obstetrics program of Mount Sinai Hospital in Toronto, Canada.
finding: Observed rates of obstetrical complications in Canadian pregnant patients with epilepsy were generally not higher than in the Canadian population, with the exception of significantly increased rates of cesarean section and postpartum hemorrhage.
mod_finding: The rate of cesarean section was significantly higher in pregnant patients with epilepsy (44%) compared to the Canadian population average (28%).
